title: ESLint Config Generator
description: Generate a flat-config eslint.config.js — rule presets, browser/node globals and custom rules.
howto: Pick a rule preset (minimal, recommended-plus, strict).
Copy the config or download eslint.config.js.

faqs.a: The eslint.config.js format used by ESLint 9 — an exported array instead of the old .eslintrc files.

faqs.q: What do I need to install?
faqs.a: npm i -D eslint @eslint/js globals — the generated file imports @eslint/js and optionally globals.
One per line as "rule-name: error" (or warn/off). They override the preset.

faqs.q: What do the environment toggles do?
faqs.a: They add the right globals (window/document for browser, process/__dirname for Node) so ESLint does not flag them as undefined.
